entries.e18821c9a599ffa3: The Medium-Term Management Plan 2029, covering July 2026 to June 2029, sets as its basic policies: enhancing group governance to achieve sustainable growth; realizing diverse work styles and maximizing human capital value; strengthening its position as a market leader and creating new market leaders; and contributing to the realization of a sustainable society through SX. In response to compliance violations at consolidated subsidiaries that occurred in the current consolidated fiscal year, it has made preventing recurrence and rebuilding internal controls the highest-priority issue for the entire company. As growth areas, it cites geological and ground surveys for nuclear power plants and nuclear fuel cycle facilities, planning and design for seismic retrofitting and aging countermeasures at Self-Defense Forces facilities, and private environmental assessment demand accompanying data center construction; it will also pursue a shift toward energy-related businesses such as offshore wind power and toward SaaS and stock-type business models that generate recurring revenue.
entries.e449e891d7e176ba: The construction consultancy services for bridge survey and design previously carried out by predecessor Dai Nippon Consultants, and the geological survey services for surveys and analysis of geology, ground, groundwater and resources previously carried out by predecessor Dia Consultants, were integrated into Dai Nippon Dia Consultants Co., Ltd. through an absorption merger in July 2023, and the group has a structure handling everything from geological surveys to design within the group.
